instruction: In Documents\Operations Queue, find the text file containing the exact marker NEBULA-305. Copy that file without moving or modifying the source into Documents\Operations Results, rename the copy to nebula_report.txt, and open the copied file to verify it.
_comments: E2 held-out evaluation variant. Never expose this variant to the recorder.

command:
from pathlib import Path; import shutil; root=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Operations Queue'); destination=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Operations Results'); shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True); shutil.rmtree(destination, ignore_errors=True); root.mkdir(parents=True); destination.mkdir(parents=True); files={'operation-a.txt':'Dispatch summary
Route: North
Priority: normal
','operation-b.txt':'Maintenance log
Machine: Delta
Status: complete
','operation-c.txt':'Shift handoff
Team: Evening
Open issues: 2
','operation-d.txt':'Incident report
Case marker: NEBULA-305
Status: resolved
'}; [(root/name).write_text(text, encoding='utf-8') for name,text in files.items()]

from pathlib import Path; source=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Operations Queue\operation-d.txt'); result=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Operations Results\nebula_report.txt'); print('true' if source.is_file() and result.is_file() and source.read_bytes() == result.read_bytes() else 'false', end='')
